description: prod-typical with availability zone 0 cut off from the other two for 30 s (all datagrams between it and the rest dropped), then healed; measures divergence during the partition, reconvergence after heal, and repair bytes.
prod-typical through a rollout wave that replaces 45 of the 80 pods (one new pod every 500 ms, the old pod leaves 5 s after its replacement starts) and one silent crash at 75 s.

prod-peak background plus 20 hot keys, each offered 5x its limit (50 req/s against 100 per 10 s) from every node for the whole run; the 60 s after warm-up measure over-admission and under-count at a binding limit.
Idle cluster: 80 pods, ~1 req/s from 3 sites every 3.2 s; measures the protocol's floor cost.

Long-window rule: 60 pods, ~30 req/s from ~96 sites every ~3.2 s against a 2,000 per hour limit with 1 min buckets, two over-limit hot keys and a 90 req/s burst for 60 s. The first full window (3,600 s) is warmed up with real traffic; 1,200 s are measured. The load is a tenth of the 300 req/s first proposed: that implies ~1.1 M live cells per pod, more than 7 GB and several hours per run, and 170x the reference deployment's live-cell count.
prod-peak with Gilbert-Elliott burst loss per directed link: 5 % mean loss in bursts of ~5 datagrams (p_good_to_bad 0.01, p_bad_to_good 0.19, all lost while bad).
Small deployment: 3 pods, ~19 req/s (32 sites every 3.2 s plus two over-limit hot keys at 1.5x and 3x a 20 req / 10 s limit).
Small deployment: 5 pods, ~19 req/s (32 sites every 3.2 s plus two over-limit hot keys at 1.5x and 3x a 20 req / 10 s limit).
Four times peak load on the autoscaler maximum: 300 pods, ~7,200 counted req/s from ~23,040 sites every ~3.2 s, plus the hot keys and burst of prod-peak.
Reference production deployment at peak: 183 pods, ~1,800 counted req/s from ~5,760 sites every ~3.2 s, two over-limit hot keys and one 90 req/s site burst; 10 s window, 1 s buckets.

Reference production deployment at its typical size: 80 pods, ~650 counted req/s from ~2,100 sites each requesting every ~3.2 s, two over-limit hot keys and one 90 req/s site burst; 10 s window, 1 s buckets.
